activities.anchor: the logic is the same: dendrites collect
activities.caption: file each player — neuron or glia
activities.name: nsCastBuckets

config.prompt: The supporting cast turned out to be genuine characters. File each description:

items.label: the cortex's principal output neurons, with long apical dendrites
receives on the order of 100,000 synaptic inputs — the most spectacular dendritic tree in biology
form the connections between; the overwhelming majority of the brain
wrap axons in myelin, the insulation that makes fast conduction possible
the brain's resident immune cells, constantly surveying, pruning and scavenging
feed neurons, help form the blood–brain barrier, and release gliotransmitters

config.why: The 19th-century protagonists mostly dismissed glia as packing material; the last three decades of neuroscience have been partly a correction — the tripartite synapse has three members, not two.

activities.anchor: in a conformational change that takes well under a millisecond
activities.caption: rebuild the release millisecond
activities.name: nsReleaseOrder

config.prompt: From arriving spike to fusion. Rebuild the release machinery:
items: The arriving action potential opens voltage-gated Ca²⁺ channels clustered in the terminal
Synaptotagmin releases the SNARE complex that was holding vesicle and membrane apart
Fusion — thousands of transmitter molecules dump into the 20-nanometre cleft
config.why: Südhof's mapped machinery earned the 2013 Nobel: a vesicle some 40 nm across, loaded with roughly 5,000 glutamate molecules, primed and waiting for calcium.

activities.anchor: an inherent uncertainty that the brain evidently tolerates
activities.caption: call the odds — the unreliable synapse
activities.name: nsReleaseEstimate

config.prompt: A synapse is not a reliable wire. Many central synapses release on only what percentage of arriving spikes (call the middle of the range)?
config.why: Only 10–50% at most central synapses — and a single vesicle's effect is a whisper well under a millivolt. Reliability is not the design goal; thousands of unreliable votes summed together are.
config.context: The neuromuscular junction is the exception: hundreds of vesicles per spike, because the muscle must absolutely twitch.

activities.anchor: here the synapse hands over to the neuron's real computation
activities.caption: pair each receiving mechanism with its action
activities.name: nsReceptorMatch

config.prompt: Two receptor families, two summations. Pair each with what it does:

pairs.right: ion channels opening within about a millisecond — the fast lane
G-proteins and intracellular cascades over tens of milliseconds to minutes — the slow lane
many inputs firing together, weighted by position on the dendritic tree

config.why: Temporal summation stacks spikes from the same input before each decays; if the vote at the axon initial segment crosses threshold, the cell fires its own spike.

activities.caption: true or false — wiring and feelings
activities.name: nsShorthandJudge

statements.s: Synapses are little wires carrying 'one thought per connection'.
statements.why: The postsynaptic cell computes by summation — the vote, not any single connection, is where the computation happens.

statements.s: Neurotransmitters map one-to-one onto feelings — there is a 'dopamine = pleasure' molecule.
statements.why: No such mapping: a transmitter's role is defined by its receptor system and circuit context.

statements.s: Dopamine in one circuit drives movement, in another motivation, in another learning.
statements.why: Same molecule, different circuits, different jobs — the shorthand hides this.

statements.s: A cortical pyramidal cell carries around 10,000 such inputs.
statements.why: A weighted voting booth of about 10,000 whispers — repeated across roughly 100 trillion synapses.

activities.anchor: Release without cleanup would saturate the cleft within seconds
activities.caption: find the faulty line — a pharmacology flashcard
activities.name: nsCleanupSpot

config.prompt: A flashcard deck on synaptic termination contains one faulty card — click it:
lines: Acetylcholinesterase hydrolyses ACh in about a millisecond — the reason a twitch ends when it ends.
Nerve agents inhibit that enzyme, so ACh lingers — up to fatal paralysis of the breathing muscles.
Donepezil, the memory drug, works by blocking reuptake of acetylcholine.
The faster the cleanup, the sharper the message; the slower, the longer the tail.
config.correction: Donepezil inhibits the breakdown enzyme — the same target class as nerve agents, listed right beside them — not a reuptake transporter.
config.why: Termination is drug target number one: enzymes, reuptake transporters, and diffusion with glial scavenging set how long every message lasts.

activities.anchor: simply top up chemicals the brain is missing
activities.caption: drag the divider — two pictures of a drug
activities.name: nsDrugCompare

config.prompt: What does a drug that acts on the synapse actually do? Drag the divider between the two pictures:

before.label: The tank view
before.text: Whatever the symptom, add the missing chemical — the brain as a reservoir to be topped up.

after.label: The machine view
after.text: Each drug grabs one step of the event — blocking reuptake (SSRIs, cocaine), inhibiting the breakdown enzyme (nerve agents, donepezil), or blocking receptors — and each interference has different consequences depending on step, transmitter and circuit.

config.why: The synapse is a machine with steps, not a reservoir — the step a drug grabs decides the consequence.

activities.anchor: The resulting calcium cascade inserts more AMPA receptors
activities.caption: fill the blanks — the rule that re-weights the brain
activities.name: nsHebbCloze

config.text: In %%0%%, Hebb proposed that when one neuron repeatedly helps fire another, the connection between them should strengthen. In 1973, Bliss and Lømo found %%1%% in the hippocampus; the %%2%% receptor — its channel blocked by a %%3%% ion at resting voltage — is the coincidence detector that turns both-sides-active into a stronger synapse.
config.hint: A year, a phenomenon, a receptor, and the ion doing the blocking.
